summary:
Zoom最新季度營收與每股盈餘雙雙優於市場預期，展現穩健的業務成長。
• 每股盈餘1.55美元，優於預期的1.48美元。
• 季度總營收達到12.8億美元，年增4.93%。
• 本益比維持在8.88的相對低檔，估值具吸引力。
ai_view:
觀點：財報表現穩健且超越預期，但營收增速放緩限制了股價爆發力。短中期需觀察企業級客戶拓展速度與AI創新功能的變現能力。

需留意：視訊通訊與協作軟體市場競爭依然激烈。；營收年增率維持在個位數，顯示高成長期已過。

summary_en:
Zoom reported better-than-expected quarterly revenue and earnings per share, demonstrating steady business growth.
• EPS came in at $1.55, beating the estimate of $1.48.
• Total quarterly revenue reached $1.28 billion, up 4.93% year-over-year.
• Trailing P/E ratio remains relatively low at 8.88, offering an attractive valuation.

ai_view_en:
view: Solid earnings beating expectations, though slowing revenue growth limits explosive upside. Near to mid-term focus should be on enterprise customer acquisition and monetization of AI features.

Watch：Intense competition persists in the video communication and collaboration software market.; Single-digit year-over-year revenue growth indicates that the high-growth phase has matured.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：每股盈餘達1.55美元，優於市場預期的1.48美元。
